test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What was the poverty headcount ratio in urban areas in 2019-21, as per the National Multidimensional Poverty Index 2023?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**5.27%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **National Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) 2023** is based on data from the **NFHS-5 (2019-21)**.
 
• The MPI measures poverty using three dimensions: **health, education, and standard of living**.
 
• In urban areas, the **poverty headcount ratio** for 2019-21 was calculated as **5.27%**, indicating a significant reduction in multidimensional poverty in urban regions.
 
• The **headcount ratio** reflects the proportion of individuals who are deprived in at least one-third of the weighted indicators.
 
• The data highlights India's progress in improving living conditions and reducing poverty in urban areas.
 
• This reduction is attributed to various government initiatives such as **housing programs, employment schemes, and improved healthcare facilities**.
 
• The report is aligned with **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)**, particularly Goal 1, which aims to eradicate poverty in all its forms.
 
• The findings underscore the importance of targeted policies in addressing urban poverty and ensuring equitable development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **National Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI)**__

 __
 
• The **MPI** is developed by the **NITI Aayog** in collaboration with **Oxford Poverty and Human Development Initiative** and the **United Nations Development Programme (UNDP).**
 
• It adopts a holistic approach to measuring poverty, moving beyond income-based assessments.
 
• The index uses **12 indicators** grouped under three dimensions: **health, education, and living standards**.
 
• Indicators include access to **nutrition, child mortality, school attendance, sanitation, and drinking water**, among others.
 
 
 
• **NFHS-5 (National Family Health Survey)**__
 
 
• The **NFHS-5** was conducted during **2019-21** and provides comprehensive data on population health, nutrition, and demographics.
 
• It is a flagship program of the **Ministry of Health and Family Welfare** in India.
 
• The survey covers **urban and rural areas**, offering valuable insights into disparities and areas requiring intervention.
